name: io.github.N0moreher0/venira-mcp
description: Workspace-scoped MCP server for coding agents: files, search, shell, checkpoints, PR/CI, audit.

environmentVariables.name: VENIRA_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the project folder the server works in. Defaults to the current directory.

environmentVariables.name: VENIRA_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the audit database and encrypted secrets. Defaults to <workspace>/data.
